product.title: Kauai Canyon Explorer: Private Tour Featuring Waimea & Kokee

description.text: Nicknamed the “Garden Isle,” Kauai is the oldest of Hawaii’s main islands, giving it time to become the lush oasis it is today. On this tour, you’ll experience its western wonders, from colorful Waimea Canyon and the 800-foot Waipoo Falls to the largest coffee orchard in the country. Stops include Waimea Canyon, Waipo'o Falls, Koke'e State Park, Kauai Coffee Company. You’ll feed chickens, cross historic swinging bridges, taste local foods, and walk away understanding Hawaii’s greatest legends. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
